issue.title: review: react-doctor finding with a missing field crashes the whole review
issue.facts: agw review fails the entire run with `undefined is not an object (evaluating 'name.replace')` on a diff. Source: packages/host/src/workflows/review/react-doctor.ts:221 passes f.rule / f.file / f.title straight into escapeName (review/util.ts:27), which calls .replace on it. A react-doctor finding without one of those fields takes down every angle, not just the react-doctor section. Fix: tolerate missing fields when formatting a finding, plus a test that feeds a finding with a missing rule and asserts the review still completes.

issue.title: web read: client-rendered pages return empty content (no wait-for-render in the fetch chain)
issue.facts: `agw web read` returns an empty extract for pages whose content is rendered client-side. The fetch chain succeeds (HTTP 200) but the HTML has no content, so the extraction model answers 'the page shows 0 items' instead of failing, which looks like a valid result. The same listing URL loaded in a real Chrome renders 30 products. Expected: the headed-Chrome step waits for render (network idle, or a selector or text) before extracting, and is used when the direct fetch yields an empty shell.

issue.title: Balance fallback does not trigger on Anthropic's 400 credit-balance refusal
issue.facts: When the Anthropic API is out of credit it answers HTTP 400 with the message 'Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API'. isBalanceError only recognises 402 and 503 'Insufficient Balance', so the call fails instead of moving to the route's fallback. Add the Anthropic phrase to the balance check, anchored so an unrelated 400 does not match, and document the case in the routes README.

Reads the organisations' admin keys. Needs a design pass, then waves.

issue.title: A wake fires when a worker ends its turn on background shells

The worker contract must say: wait for background work in the foreground before ending a turn. Edit the /wave skill's roles/worker.md and the fan brief template; no factory code change.
